result_text:
The "Undefined Team" remainder now only collects active contributors. I haven't added a test for the new filter. I ran the existing `Landscape*` tests in `codeanalyzer` and they passed.

The change is one condition in `getAllTeams()` in `LandscapeContributorsAggregator.java`. An unmatched contributor is added to the remainder only if `contributor.getContributor().isActive()` is true. Dormant unmatched contributors are skipped. Configured teams are unchanged and keep all their members.

Contributors with a blank latest-commit date count as active, because `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange` already returns true for a blank date.
